programmes.d: A Confederate (Randolph Scott) and his men rob Union gold in Nevada, then learn the war's been over for a month.

Still leading the cattle drive, Bill takes his herd across a powerful rancher's land; he finds a woman who claims she is fleeing from a rancher's advances, but he learns that she isn't telling the whole truth.
A former lawman who lost his nerve after a shooting incident is being harassed by brothers of a man he once killed; the ex-lawman's daughter refuses to let him fight back.
Bill travels to Ciudad Juárez to accept a job from a cattleman, only to find out he's actually been hired to become a scapegoat in a counterfeiting scheme.

A rancher warns Bill and the railroad workers not to put track down through the land his cattle graze on, even though it is government land; he shoots one of the workers, which sends the rest of the workers into a lynching mood.

The Epitaph's editor, Claiborne, follows up on a report that a notorious outlaw is living in Tombstone as a respected citizen; Hollister gets clues from a strange poker result and a spur taken in a mugging; two residents become the prime suspects.
Ed Keel is out for revenge on an injured Hollister after the hanging of his brother.
A new bank in North Fork is in danger of being robbed.
Mark tries to play Cupid for his father and a pretty young stranger who arrives in town.
A criminal threatens to harm Mark unless Lucas sells him the ranch.
A young man takes over the duties of the sheriff, who is out of town.
Bat arrives in town too late to stop the Dakota boys from killing his friend, the sheriff; when the town asks Bat to take over the position, Bat provides another option.
Bat helps a woman and her son break away from the Doolin gang and flee to St. Louis, but the boy feels a strong attachment to the criminals that he considers family.
A madman steals ten cases of dynamite from the arsenal to bomb New Orleans.
Female pirate Coco LaSalle steals a package addressed to Yancy from Paris.

Bill tries to find out who's supplying whiskey to railroad workers during their working hours in order to halt railroad progress; he first suspects a saloon owner, but it becomes clear she's not the guilty party.
Bill agrees to take his former Civil War commander's oldest son with him to make a man out of him; Bill quickly detects the son has an intense bitterness towards his father.
Josh hunts outlaw brothers who shot a sheriff.
Josh's former commanding officer has his name on a wanted poster.
Following the murder of an old prospector, a detective sets out to locate his killer and the four heirs to his will.

programmes.t: The Last of the Fast Guns
programmes.d: A U.S. tycoon hires an 1880s gunfighter (Jock Mahoney) to find his brother in Mexico.
President Arthur helps a rich rancher (Robert Taylor) fight advocates of open grazing in the Territory of Wyoming.
Drifters stumble onto a remote town where they are sentenced to death.
A woman swears vengeance when her husband is killed in a dispute over water rights.
Town exacts vengeance upon an embittered man who shot a prominent citizen.
A man contemplates failure.
A man helps a widow run a ranch after her husband is killed.
An elderly man is thwarted in his efforts to prove his identity.
A son watches his father hang, then seeks revenge on the sheriff.
A successful man's son needs to come out from under his father's shadow.
A stage line driver is framed in the looting of strongboxes by the stage line owner and freighter.
Cisco and Pancho discover a phony cattle epidemic created by a greedy buyer.
A gunfighter (Randolph Scott) loses his beloved in a robbery and hunts the man (George Macready) to blame, who is living off the loot.
Bat Masterson and a determined land agent work to make a lawless Kansas cow town safe for wheat farmers.
